_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score remains inside Denial band; only legal +1 step is Anxiety if early recovery continues, otherwise coil/HOLD is the skilled base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst wanted Disbelief (rejected as >1 rung); narrative supplies bearish flow data without a forward phase, so consensus forces adjacent Anxiety or stay Denial with HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_momentum_30d rises further and fear_greed holds above mid-50s while etf_flows stabilize non-negative
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows turn sustainably negative or stablecoin_growth breaks lower, pushing score back toward Panic
